# SYNTHETIC SAMPLE — invented numbers, not results

**Every value in this folder was generated by a formula.** The site does not exist, the
horizon is two triangle waves, the ground is a formula made to go with them, the Sun and the Earth move on invented circles, the body
radii and the sphere radius are invented round numbers, and the UTC labels ignore the
offset between TDB and UTC. Nothing here may be quoted, plotted as a finding or shown to
anyone as output of the tool.

The sample exists so that readers (web charts, Three.js view, Unreal scene, event finder)
can be written and tested against the exact file layout of the contract before real data
is available. Each package says `"synthetic": true`, carries a `synthetic_notice`, and
every method card has validation status `synthetic`.

| Path | Content |
|---|---|
| `SYNTHETIC_scenario.json` | The scenario the sample was produced from |
| `packages/index.json` | List of the packages below |
| `packages/direction_table/<id>/` | Direction-table package: 769 hourly records, Sun and Earth |
| `packages/site/synthetic-sample-site-b/<id>/` | A second invented site with the same content, so that two sites can be compared |
| `packages/site_pairs/<id>/` | Site-pairs package: what the two invented sites achieve together |
| `packages/site/synthetic-sample-site/<id>/` | Site package: horizon for 6 observer heights and 1440 azimuths with its obstacles (four per height: an invented far ridge, an invented near rock field and two stretches between them), a 30-day hourly series, events, windows, metrics, the blocker of every sample and the time lost to each obstacle, the lunar-day calendar, and the landing windows and slip tolerance for the invented example requirement of the scenario, the band for an invented horizon error and the survey of an invented landing ellipse (9 points), and the mast-height trade table |

Each site package also holds three small terrain patches (65 x 65 nodes at 20, 80 and
320 m; 50 700 bytes together; the scenario states them, real packages use larger ones).
The surface is invented to go with the invented horizon at observer height 0: it never
rises above that horizon, and it touches it in the 252 of 1440 azimuths whose invented
limiting distance lies inside the patches (0.02 degrees below in the median, up to 1
degree at the invented cliffs, where the invented distance jumps).

Regenerate and check:

```
python -m lsncore sample
python -m lsncore validate docs/contract/sample/packages/site/synthetic-sample-site/*
```

The files are not edited by hand. A test (`core/tests/test_contract.py`) validates them
and compares them with a fresh run.
